metadata.name: Value
metadata.description: Returns a value shaped from its inputs — mapped fields, a built response body, joined text or a constant — with optional named intermediate values. Declares the input and result types it is checked against before it runs and at every call.

inputType.title: Input Type
inputType.description: The input contract, a named type reference or an inline type definition. Defaults are filled and every call is validated against it; the body reads the inputs as `inputs.<name>`.

outputType.title: Output Type
outputType.description: The result contract, a named type reference or an inline type definition. It types the result for callers, is checked against `value` statically and validates the produced value at every call.

bindings.title: Bindings
bindings.description: Named intermediate values, read by bare name by `value` and by each other. Order follows what each one references, and each is computed at most once per call, only if something reads it.

value.title: Value
value.description: A `!cel` expression, or a map or list with `!cel` leaves, evaluated at each call over `inputs` and the bindings. The result may be any shape: object, list, scalar or constant.
